name: cc-usage-mod
description: Shows project, model, context, cost and rate limits in a band above the Claude Code prompt

layout.title: Layout
layout.description: Widgets per line. Separate lines with |, and tokens within a line with commas or spaces. A token equal to a widget ID is that widget; otherwise each character is a preset letter. Letters: P projectInfo, N projectName, G repoInfo, M model, C context, $ cost, R rateLimit5h, 7 rateLimit7d, L spendLimit. Unknown characters are ignored, and an empty result falls back to NMC$R7L. Examples: PMC$|R7L, projectInfo, model | rateLimit5h rateLimit7d

disabledWidgets.title: Disabled widgets
disabledWidgets.description: Widgets to hide even when the layout lists them, as preset letters or widget IDs separated by commas, spaces or |. Letters: P projectInfo, N projectName, G repoInfo, M model, C context, $ cost, R rateLimit5h, 7 rateLimit7d, L spendLimit. Example: $, rateLimit7d

theme.title: Theme
theme.description: Color theme of the band. Context and rate limit percentages use the theme's safe color up to 50%, warning up to 80%, and danger above.

separator.title: Separator
separator.description: Separator between widgets: pipe (│), dot (·), arrow (›) or space (two spaces).

language.title: Language
language.description: Language of the rate limit labels and reset countdown: en (5h, 7d, 1d 2h) or ko (5시간, 7일, 1일 2시간). auto uses Korean when LC_ALL, LC_MESSAGES or LANG starts with ko, and English otherwise.

contextBarWidth.title: Context bar width
contextBarWidth.description: Number of cells in the context usage bar, a whole number from 1 to 40. Values outside 1-40 or with a fraction fall back to 8.
